description: Source code for a tool that checks Kubernetes conformance end-to-end test files for compliance with specific requirements, including verifying that tests do not call skip functions and that conformance tests are properly structured.

methods.name: checkAllProviders
methods.description: Checks a given e2e test file to ensure conformance tests do not call skip functions and are properly structured.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a directory to find Go test files and runs checkAllProviders on each.

methods.name: processDir
methods.description: Recursively processes directories to find and check Go test files.

methods.name: newCommand
methods.description: Creates a Cobra command for running the conformance test requirements check.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the command.
